outline: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.
schedule:
Wk 1~Wk 3  : Chapter 2 : Limits and Derivatives
Wk 4~Wk 5  : Chapter 3 : Inverse Functions
Wk 6~Wk 8  : Chapter 4 : Applications of Differentiation
Wk 9: Midterm
Wk 10~Wk 12 : Chapter 5 : Integrals
Wk 13~Wk 15  : Chapter 6 : Techniques of Integration
Wk 16  : Final
Wk 17~Wk 18: Chapter 7 : Applications of Integration(Long-Distance)

flexible_learning.content: Materials will be recorded and posted in youtube. Students learn the material by themselves. In addition, students can discuss the materials that they don't understand with instructor during  class time. After that, students have to do HW questions for evaluation.
flexible_learning.outcome: Students have to turn in their HW on line before deadline.
flexible_learning.assessment_ratio: There are 10% out of 100 points(5% for each week).
